desc: The Pistol Tool is ideal for mounting accessories, field disassembly, adjusting laser sights and changing grips. The tool has a compact design that fits conveniently into most standard pistol mag pouches and each tool locks open. This pistol tool also has Titanium coated stainless steel components, 1911 government and officer bushing wrench, four Bondhus Protanium hex keys for laser sights, non-hardened stainless steel pick/scraper, 2.5" long bit driver, 3/32" pin punch with 8-32 threads, 3" Tanto knife, 6 hex bits with ball detents, fine tooth metal file and a tap hammer surface.
